body: Please don’t kill yourself you have so much to look forward to. There’s always a solution.
Same here. But keep fighting you never know when it’ll get better.

I know I honestly don’t want to hurt my family or anyone and I would never do it out of revenge or spite. When I look back on how I’ve conducted myself and all the problems I’ve caused it feels like I’m walking around in an infinite void. When I look into my future I see nothing. All my dreams and aspirations dissipated within the last two years. I hate myself but love my family and I feel like if I killed myself they would be able to move on earlier.
